# The enabled NNTP content test checks normalized stream data rather than channel contentLength

The rewritten test awaits folder loading and channel streaming, normalizes CRLF, then compares the received string length and entire fixture string. It no longer checks pre-open channel.contentLength and drops the old attachment-only construction. The fake adds a missing bytes header from text.length, which HEAD returns from its header map. These source assertions and fake string metadata do not prove encoded byte length, attachment transfer or a fresh test result.

Scope: NNTP channel stream test and fake HEAD metadata.
